lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
viewer-init: 13,677 B beyond the first copy, focus-trap 13,656 B, vue-demi 13 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 8 B.
viewer-main: 8 B beyond the first copy, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 8 B.
All 2 pages load the same 2 files: 849,577 B raw, 246,003 B gzip, 93.9 % of the smallest page (viewer-main, 904,727 B).
Inside: @nextcloud/dialogs 285,522 B, webdav 131,412 B, vue 75,323 B, @nextcloud/vue 57,587 B, axios 51,631 B.
1,707 B in 13 pieces of 3 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (152 packages, 1,169 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
